raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`_mega_moe_mma_type()` already selects packed-fp4 (`mxf4xmxf4`) for mxfp4 quant, but `kimi_k3.py::_forward_mega_experts` only ships the fp8 pre-dispatch, so `--moe-a2a-backend megamoe` on an mxfp4 target cannot serve. This ports the mxf4 branch `mega_moe.py` already carries (same split, same buffer geometry the allocator produces: hidden/2 packed rows). Tracking issue with full findings: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/43294

## Modifications

One file (+27/−10): in `_forward_mega_experts`, route `mma_type == "mxf4xmxf4"` through `deep_gemm.mega_moe_pre_dispatch` (which emits E2M1-packed activations) and keep the existing sglang JIT FP8 pre-dispatch for `fp8xfp4`; the else-branch preserves the original call byte-for-byte. `nvfp4xnvfp4` is unchanged/out of scope (K3 checkpoints are mxfp4; it was equally unreachable before this PR).

**Sequencing:** (a) safe to merge now — the new branch is inert on `fp8xfp4`, and `SymmBuffer.mma_type` + `mega_moe_pre_dispatch(..., mma_type=)` already exist in the pinned `sgl-deep-gemm==0.2.1.post1` wheel; (b) the mxf4 path activates once sgl-project/DeepGEMM#100 ships in an sgl-deep-gemm release and the pin is bumped (happy to file that bump); (c) until then an mxf4 attempt fails at DeepGEMM's explicit situ assert instead of today's opaque TensorMatcher error.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K 1319-q A/B x2 (greedy, fresh server per run; #42022 template): patched pooled **0.9769** vs stock **0.9742** (Δ +0.27%, pre-registered gate |Δ| ≤ 1.2% passed; 0 request errors all runs). Greedy prefix-equivalence caveat disclosed in the tracking issue. Raw outputs + runner: https://gist.github.com/ZhimaoL/aec832cf92f62f374e90936603fe3259

Repro:
```
# server (patched arm), 8xB300 TP8, image sha b1259f3e
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <Kimi-K3> --trust-remote-code --tp-size 8 \
  --speculative-algorithm DFLASH --speculative-draft-model-path <Kimi-K3-DFlash> \
  --speculative-dflash-block-size 7 --attention-backend trtllm_mla \
  --speculative-draft-attention-backend trtllm_mha --linear-attn-verify-backend nv_cutedsl \
  --enable-linear-replayssm-spec --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 \
  --moe-a2a-backend megamoe --enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe --mem-fraction-static 0.82
# evaluation
python gsm8k_ab.py --base http://127.0.0.1:8001/v1 --n 1319 --out out.json   # runner in the gist
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

bs=1 decode: accept 3.170, step 40.24 ms (W4A8 form 41.77 ms) — feature-completion, no speedup claimed; launch-structure context in the tracking issue.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code: lint passed on this branch (ruff/ruff-format clean, no new violations vs base)
- [ ] Add unit tests — none added: the branch needs a live multi-rank symm buffer group; validated by 2 fresh patched serves + GSM8K A/B x2. Happy to add one if pointed at the preferred harness.
- [x] Update documentation as needed — n/a (no user-facing flag change; enabling flags already exist)
- [x] Provide accuracy results — above + gist
- [x] Provide speed results — above (no speedup claimed)

Requires the DeepGEMM companion: https://github.com/sgl-project/DeepGEMM/pull/100

-            buf.x,
-            buf.x_sf,
-            buf.topk_idx,

-            quant_group_size=32,

+        if buf.mma_type == "nvfp4xnvfp4":
+            # Explicitly out of scope: the fp8 JIT pre-dispatch below would feed
+            # fp8 activations into an nvfp4-typed buffer, and DeepGEMM's situ
+            # gate rejects NVFP4 by design. Fail loudly instead of corrupting.
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MegaMoE situ pre-dispatch supports fp8xfp4 and mxf4xmxf4 only; "
+                "nvfp4xnvfp4 is not implemented (see sgl-project/sglang#43294)."
+            )
+        if buf.mma_type == "mxf4xmxf4":
+            # The packed-FP4 path goes through DeepGEMM's own pre-dispatch,
+            # which emits E2M1-packed activations; sglang's JIT pre-dispatch
+            # only emits FP8 (see mega_moe.py for the same split).
+            deep_gemm.mega_moe_pre_dispatch(
+                routed_input,
+                topk_ids_in,
+                topk_weights_in,
+                buf.x,
+                buf.x_sf,
+                buf.topk_idx,
+                buf.topk_weights,
+                num_tokens=num_tokens,
+                group_size=32,
+                mma_type=buf.mma_type,
+            )
+        else:
+            mega_moe_pre_dispatch(
+                routed_input,
+                topk_ids_in,
+                topk_weights_in,
+                buf.x,
+                buf.x_sf,
+                buf.topk_idx,
+                buf.topk_weights,
+                quant_group_size=32,
+            )
         # At least one row so the tvm-ffi binding sees a non-null data_ptr.
         y = torch.empty(
             (max(num_tokens, 1), self.moe_hidden_size),
